title: The useContext Hook
description: Master consuming context values with the useContext hook.

data.text: **useContext** is the hook for consuming context values. It accepts a context object and returns the current context value.

data.title: useContext
Theme Toggle

data.text: You can use multiple useContext hooks in a single component to consume different contexts.

data.title: Multiple Contexts
Custom Hook for Context
data.text: Create a custom hook to consume context with validation: `function useTheme() { return useContext(ThemeContext) }`

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Can use multiple useContext in one component
Create custom hooks for cleaner consumption
data.takeaway: useContext makes context consumption clean and simple.
